composition_distinctness_resolution_2026.trigger: Supervised e2e Validation Run 2 (episode ep_74237788, topic 'The Voynich Manuscript') was rejected by thumbnail_qa.py's c_thumbnail_composition_distinctness check: all 3 ranked A/B/C candidates (triggers impossibility, betrayal, discovery) shared composition_plan.focal_zone='center_right'. This was the real-provider V5.1 test this file's prior 'next_action' had been waiting for -- it succeeded at the generation level and failed at this one downstream QA check.
composition_distinctness_resolution_2026.root_cause: Two separate, individually deliberate design decisions, made 10 days apart by the same author, were never reconciled. (1) commit 8cbc1d0 (2026-06-21, same day thumbnail_composition_planner.py was created) intentionally consolidated _TRIGGER_MAP's focal_zone values under a 'CTR-first composition' redesign ('Drives CTR through subject readability and contrast, not void maximisation') -- 6 of 7 triggers ended up sharing focal_zone='center_right', down from 3 distinct values in the original map. (2) commit 7ee79f8 (2026-07-01) added c_thumbnail_composition_distinctness, requiring the 3 ranked candidates to have non-identical focal_zone, with no cross-check against the already-consolidated trigger map and no corresponding change to it. The 2026-07-13 Antikythera V3-V5 blueprints only validated that the pre-existing 'impossibility' trigger value reproduces a good single-thumbnail composition -- they did not originate 'center_right' and say nothing about cross-candidate distinctness. Full evidence trail (git history, blueprint doc quotes) preserved in the session transcript; not duplicated in code comments beyond the summary in thumbnail_composition_planner.py.
composition_distinctness_resolution_2026.fix: Candidate-assembly-layer fix, not a DNA change. _TRIGGER_MAP is untouched (still frozen, still CTR-first). New resolve_composition_distinctness() in hypogeum/agents/thumbnail_composition_planner.py runs once over the assembled ranked_candidates list in hypogeum/agents/thumbnail_prompt_writer.py::_attach_concept_plans() (the real candidate-assembly layer). Rank 1's composition_plan is never modified (provably, not just by convention -- it's always the first candidate processed against an empty claimed-zones set). Ranks 2/3 are deterministically reassigned, only on actual collision, to the first unclaimed zone in a fixed 3-zone pool: FOCAL_ZONE_RESOLUTION_POOL = ('center_left', 'center', 'center_right') -- all three zones already proven safe/meaningful in this system (two already used in _TRIGGER_MAP itself; 'center_left' is the exact term from the hand-authored, provider-validated Antikythera V3/V4 blueprint's doorway/figure zone). No randomness, no topic-specific logic. Confirmed that focal_zone is structural metadata only in the current codebase -- it drives no image_prompt text (describe_dna_constraints() and build_layer_prompts() never read it), so this fix has zero effect on what the generated image actually looks like; it only changes which validator bucket a lower-ranked candidate's plan falls into.
composition_distinctness_resolution_2026.verification: Directly reproduced Run 2's exact failing scenario (impossibility/betrayal/discovery, all center_right) and confirmed the real thumbnail_qa.py Check I logic now passes against the resolved output. 20 new regression tests added to tests/test_thumbnail_composition_typography.py (TestResolveCompositionDistinctness + TestConceptCandidatePlansDistinctness): collision resolution for 3-shared / 2-shared / already-distinct cases, rank-1 immutability (including out-of-order input), field-preservation (only focal_zone changes), determinism across repeated runs, _TRIGGER_MAP immutability, empty/single/no-plan edge cases, and compatibility with both validate_thumbnail_dna() and validate_composition_typography_pre_generation(). Targeted thumbnail suite (640 tests across 14 files) passes; full suite result recorded separately below.
